Fudbalski klub Proleter Teslić is a football club from Teslić, in Republika Srpska, Bosnia and Herzegovina. They play in the second division of the Republika Srpska championship. Until 2007 Proleter was playing in the 2nd division, when they qualified for the first league after 11 years. The club plays its home matches on the Radolinka stadium.
